system.noReportAskOperator: Ask an operator or administrator to start the first check.
system.runNotFoundDescription: Run {{id}} has no saved report: it may be of another kind or already out of the history.
system.error: The check did not finish completely
system.findingsLink: View the open findings from these checks

integrity.title: Package integrity
integrity.subtitle: System files checked against the installed package, plus package and repository signatures
integrity.noReportDescription: The check compares every installed file with the size, digest and permissions recorded in the package (rpm -Va, dpkg --verify) and checks signatures.
integrity.debsumsMissing: debsums not installed: the check uses dpkg --verify only. To also check configuration files, install it with apt install debsums.
integrity.files: Files that differ from the package
integrity.filesEmpty: No file differs from what the packages recorded.
integrity.filesCaption: Files that differ from the package, most severe first
integrity.truncated: The list shows the first {{shown}}; the other {{count}} are in the findings list.
integrity.methodPackage: Each RPM package has its own signature, checked at install time.
integrity.methodRepository: On Debian and Ubuntu the signature belongs to the repository index, checked by APT when downloading the lists.
integrity.signed: Packages signed with a known key
integrity.reposCaption: Configured repositories and whether signatures are checked

updates.title: Updates and restarts
updates.subtitle: Pending security fixes, services using replaced libraries and pending reboot
updates.noReportDescription: The check uses the package lists the server already downloaded: it installs nothing and does not use the network.
updates.cacheNever: The package manager has no downloaded lists: pending fixes cannot be checked.
updates.cacheStale: The lists are more than 7 days old: recent fixes may be missing.
updates.refreshOff: VigiaHost does not download the lists on its own: the system's automatic updates (dnf-automatic, unattended-upgrades) or the team keep them current. To download the lists before each check, root sets "refresh_package_metadata": true in /etc/vigiahost/executor.json.
updates.refreshed: The lists were updated in this check.
updates.securityEmpty: No pending security fix in the current lists.
updates.securityCaption: Packages with a pending security fix
updates.rebootUnknownHint: The running kernel did not come from a package (container, WSL) and needs-restarting or needrestart is missing.
updates.servicesEmpty: No service is running with a replaced library or executable.
updates.servicesCaption: Services still using files replaced by updates
updates.processesCaption: Processes outside services that use replaced files

toolHint.needs-restarting: For the official service list and pending reboot on RHEL and derivatives: dnf install dnf-utils (EL 8 and 9) or dnf install dnf-plugins-core.
toolHint.needrestart: For the service list and pending kernel on Debian and Ubuntu: apt install needrestart.
